text_en: “Then the kingdom of heaven will be like this. Ten bridesmaids took their lamps and went to meet the bridegroom.
text_cn: “那时，天国好比十个童女，拿着自己的灯，出去迎接新郎。

text_en: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
text_cn: 她们中五个是糊涂的，五个是明智的。

text_en: When the foolish took their lamps, they took no oil with them;
text_cn: 糊涂的拿了灯，却没有随身带油；

text_en: but the wise took flasks of oil with their lamps.
text_cn: 而明智的拿了灯，并且在壶里带了油。

text_en: As the bridegroom was delayed, all of them became drowsy and slept.
text_cn: 因为新郎迟延，她们都打盹睡着了。

text_en: But at midnight there was a shout, ‘Look! Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him. ’
text_cn: 半夜有人喊说：新郎来了，你们出来迎接吧！

text_en: Then all those bridesmaids got up and trimmed their lamps.
text_cn: 那些童女遂都起来，装备她们的灯。

text_en: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out. ’
text_cn: 糊涂的对明智的说：把你们的油，分些给我们吧！因为我们的灯快要灭了！

text_en: But the wise replied, ‘No! there will not be enough for you and for us; you had better go to the dealers and buy some for yourselves. ’
text_cn: 明智的答说：怕为我们和你们都不够，更好你们到卖油的那里去，为自己买吧！

text_en: And while they went to buy it, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went with him into the wedding banquet; and the door was shut.
text_cn: 她们去买的时候，新郎到了；那准备好了的，就同他进去，共赴婚宴；门遂关上了。

text_en: Later the other bridesmaids came also, saying, ‘Lord, lord, open to us. ’
text_cn: 末后，其余的童女也来了，说：主啊！主啊！给我们开门吧！

text_en: But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I do not know you. ’
text_cn: 他却答说：我实在告诉你们：我不认识你们。

text_en: Keep awake therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hour.
text_cn: 所以，你们该醒寤，因为你们不知道那日子，也不知道那时辰。”

text_en: “For it is as if a man, going on a journey, summoned his slaves and entrusted his property to them;
text_cn: “天国又如一个要远行的人，将自己的仆人叫来，把财产托付给他们：

text_en: to one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his ability. Then he went away.
text_cn: 按照他们的才能，一个给了五个‘塔冷通’，一个给了两个，一个给了一个；然后动身走了。

text_en: The one who had received the five talents went off at once and traded with them, and made five more talents.
text_cn: 那领了五个‘塔冷通’的，立刻去用来营业，另外赚了五个。

text_en: In the same way, the one who had the two talents made two more talents.
text_cn: 同样，那领了两个的，也赚了另外两个。

text_en: But the one who had received the one talent went off and dug a hole in the ground and hid his master’s money.
text_cn: 但是，那领了一个的，却去掘开地，把主人的银子藏了。

text_en: After a long time the master of those slaves came and settled accounts with them.
text_cn: 过了多时，仆人的主人回来了，便与他们算账。

text_en: Then the one who had received the five talents came forward, bringing five more talents, saying, ‘Master, you handed over to me five talents; see, I have made five more talents. ’
text_cn: 那领了五个‘塔冷通’的上前来，呈上另外五个‘塔冷通’说：主啊！你曾交给我五个‘塔冷通’，看，我赚了另外五个‘塔冷通’。

text_en: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and trustworthy slave; you have been trustworthy in a few things, I will put you in charge of many things; enter into the joy of your master. ’
text_cn: 主人对他说：好！善良忠信的仆人，你既在少许事上忠信，我必委派你管理许多大事：进入你主人的福乐吧！

text_en: And the one with the two talents also came forward, saying, ‘Master, you handed over to me two talents; see, I have made two more talents. ’
text_cn: 那领了两个‘塔冷通’的也前来说：主啊！你曾交给我两个‘塔冷通’，看，我赚了另外两个‘塔冷通’。

text_en: His master said to him, ‘Well done, good and trustworthy slave; you have been trustworthy in a few things, I will put you in charge of many things; enter into the joy of your master. ’
text_cn: 主人对他说：好！善良忠信的仆人！你既在少许事上忠信，我必委派你管理许多大事：进入你主人的福乐吧！

text_en: Then the one who had received the one talent also came forward, saying, ‘Master, I knew that you were a harsh man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you did not scatter seed;
text_cn: 随后，那领了一个‘塔冷通’的也前来说：主啊！我原知道你是个刻薄的人，在你没有下种的地方收割，在你没有散布的地方聚敛。

text_en: so I was afraid, and I went and hid your talent in the ground. Here you have what is yours. ’
text_cn: 因为我害怕，所以我去把你的‘塔冷通’藏在地下；看，你的仍还给你。

text_en: But his master replied, ‘You wicked and lazy slave! You knew, did you, that I reap where I did not sow, and gather where I did not scatter?
text_cn: 主人回答说：可恶懒惰的仆人！你既知道：我在没有下种的地方收割，在没有散布的地方聚敛；

text_en: Then you ought to have invested my money with the bankers, and on my return I would have received what was my own with interest.
text_cn: 那么，你就该把我的银子，交给钱庄里的人，待我回来时，把我的连本带利取回。

text_en: So take the talent from him, and give it to the one with the ten talents.
text_cn: 所以，你们把这个‘塔冷通’从他手中夺过来，给那有了十个‘塔冷通’的，

text_en: For to all those who have, more will be given, and they will have an abundance; but from those who have nothing, even what they have will be taken away.
text_cn: 因为凡是有的，还要给他，叫他富裕；那没有的，连他所有的，也要由他手中夺去。

text_en: As for this worthless slave, throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth. ’
text_cn: 至于这无用的仆人，你们把他丢在外面的黑暗中，在那里必有哀号和切齿。”

text_en: “When the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
text_cn: “当人子在自己的光荣中，与众天使一同降来时，那时，他要坐在光荣的宝座上，

text_en: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats,
text_cn: 一切的民族，都要聚在他面前；他要把他们彼此分开，如同牧人分开绵羊和山羊一样：

text_en: and he will put the sheep at his right hand and the goats at the left.
text_cn: 把绵羊放在自己的右边，山羊在左边。

text_en: Then the king will say to those at his right hand, ‘Come, you that are blessed by my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;
text_cn: 那时，君王要对那些在他右边的说：我父所祝福的，你们来吧！承受自创世以来，给你们预备了的国度吧！

text_en: for I was hungry and you gave me food, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you welcomed me,
text_cn: 因为我饿了，你们给了我吃的；我渴了，你们给了我喝的；我作客，你们收留了我：

text_en: I was naked and you gave me clothing, I was sick and you took care of me, I was in prison and you visited me. ’
text_cn: 我赤身露体，你们给了我穿的；我患病，你们看顾了我；我在监里，你们来探望了我。

text_en: Then the righteous will answer him, ‘Lord, when was it that we saw you hungry and gave you food, or thirsty and gave you something to drink?
text_cn: 那时，义人回答他说：主啊！我们什么时候见了你饥饿而供养了你，或口渴而给了你喝的？

text_en: And when was it that we saw you a stranger and welcomed you, or naked and gave you clothing?
text_cn: 我们什么时候见了你作客，而收留了你，或赤身露体而给了你穿的？

text_en: And when was it that we saw you sick or in prison and visited you? ’
text_cn: 我们什么时候见你患病，或在监里而来探望过你？

text_en: And the king will answer them, ‘Truly I tell you, just as you did it to one of the least of these who are members of my family, you did it to me. ’
text_cn: 君王便回答他们说：我实在告诉你们：凡你们对我这些最小兄弟中的一个所做的，就是对我做的。

text_en: Then he will say to those at his left hand, ‘You that are accursed, depart from me into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels;
text_cn: 然后他又对那些在左边的说：可咒骂的，离开我，到那给魔鬼和他的使者预备的永火里去吧！

text_en: for I was hungry and you gave me no food, I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink,
text_cn: 因为我饿了，你们没有给我吃的；我渴了，你们没有给我喝的；

text_en: I was a stranger and you did not welcome me, naked and you did not give me clothing, sick and in prison and you did not visit me. ’
text_cn: 我作客，你们没有收留我；我赤身露体，你们没有给我穿的；我患病或在监里，你们没有来探望我。

text_en: Then they also will answer, ‘Lord, when was it that we saw you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not take care of you? ’
text_cn: 那时，他们也要回答说：主啊！我们几时见了你饥饿，或口渴，或作客，或赤身露体，或有病，或坐监，而我们没有给你效劳？

text_en: Then he will answer them, ‘Truly I tell you, just as you did not do it to one of the least of these, you did not do it to me. ’
text_cn: 那时，君王回答他们说：我实在告诉你们：凡你们没有给这些最小中的一个做的，便是没有给我做。

text_en: And these will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life. ”
text_cn: 这些人要进入永罚，而那些义人却要进入永生。”
